title: tshark: null output mode for testing cmdline args
description:
Add `-T none` to tshark. This mode prevents all capturing, reading, and
writing. Intended for use with testing the validity of other
command-line options, particularly for testing the validity of display
filter expressions with `-Y`.

One possible approach for #19505. I don't know if I like it.
